Question: Isabella must take four \(100\)-point tests in her math class. Her goal is to achieve an average grade of at least \(95\) on the tests. Her first two test scores were \(97\) and \(91.\) After seeing her score on the third test, she realized that she could still reach her goal. What is the lowest possible score she could have made on the third test?
